verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents webhooks that send signed HTTPS requests on events like pushes or merged pull requests. That is a developer building block: the user must build the action on their own server, so it is not a rule-to-action automation feature. Rulesets are an adjacent control that gates branches with required reviews and checks rather than triggering actions, and no native event-triggered automation rules engine is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
